Title: 2022-07-12 Live Patch
Subtitle: Hero rotation schedule updates, 4 new seasonal Ranked quests, Epic Chaos Lizard mount login reward, and Spectral Butcher skin.
Highlights: Hero rotation schedule updates, 4 new seasonal Ranked quests, Epic Chaos Lizard mount login reward, and Spectral Butcher skin.
CleanedNotes:
=== General ===
  • Hero Rotation will update every 1st, 8th, 15th, and 22nd of every month.
  • Each new Season will now have 4 New Seasonal Quests for new Ranked Season.

=== Shop ===
  • Epic Chaos Lizard Mount has been added for Login reward.
  • Spectral Butcher Skin is now available for purchase.
